Overview & City Profile

Geroldswil (Geroldswil (BFS 244)) is a municipality in Bezirk Dietikon, Canton of Zurich (coordinates 47.4207°N, 8.4119°E; population 4,934). Visitors use Geroldswil as a base to explore Canton of Zurich's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with Rösti, Luxemburgerli macarons, Fondue in historic guild houses.

Within Canton of Zurich Region (Bezirk Dietikon region), Geroldswil (Geroldswil (BFS 244)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in canton of zurich region. Travelers exploring Canton of Zurich often combine a stop in Geroldswil with regional highlights such as Zürich Altstadt & Limmatquai, Lake Zurich cruises & Uetliberg, Kunsthaus Zürich & Landesmuseum, Winterthur museums & Rhine Falls gateway.

Getting to Geroldswil & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Zurich Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Zurich Airport (ZRH) has a mainline SBB railway station underneath the terminal (10 min to Zürich HB).

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Canton of Zurich Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Zurich with Geroldswil. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Canton of Zurich have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Geroldswil en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Geroldswil are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Canton of Zurich can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Switzerland Guide.

Practical Travel Tips for Geroldswil

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Geroldswil (or at Zurich Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Geroldswil accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Geroldswil (Geroldswil (BFS 244)) located in Switzerland?

Geroldswil (Geroldswil (BFS 244)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Canton of Zurich Region in the Bezirk Dietikon region of Switzerland (coordinates: 47.4207°N, 8.4119°E). It has a population of approximately 4,934 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Geroldswil by train?

Most visitors reach Geroldswil via the main prefectural gateway of Zurich Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Zurich Airport (ZRH) has a mainline SBB railway station underneath the terminal (10 min to Zürich HB). From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Geroldswil. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Geroldswil and Canton of Zurich known for?

In Geroldswil and across Canton of Zurich Region, top local dishes include Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with Rösti, Luxemburgerli macarons, Fondue in historic guild houses, as well as Craft chocolate. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Geroldswil?

Best time to visit Canton of Zurich: May–Sep, Dec (Christmas markets). Check our Switzerland Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
